open_points.subject: startup recovery of a run with both ready and waiting elements
open_points.text: “A run derived `running` is advanced with `runs`' own advance, which reaches every ready element while other elements still wait …; a run derived still waiting is not advanced”
open_points.question: When recovery finds at least one ready element and at least one element still waiting, does `run_graph` derive `running` so `runs` advances the ready element, or derive `awaiting_approval`/`pending` because a wait exists and therefore perform no advance?
options: Derive `running` whenever any element is ready, advance all possible work, and store a waiting status only after no ready element remains
Derive `awaiting_approval` or `pending` whenever any wait exists, and do not advance other ready elements during recovery
open_points.default_guess: Derive `running` whenever any element is ready, matching A13 rule 8, then advance until only waits remain.
